name: VivaBench
intro: VivaBench 是面向LLM智能体顺序临床推理能力的多轮口试式基准。模型须在Review和Investigation阶段主动询问病史、体检、影像与检验信息，先提交初步诊断，再提交最终诊断，并与完整信息条件对照。
org: Georgia Institute of Technology, University of Toronto, University of Cambridge
metric: 初步/最终/完整信息阶段的Top-k精确与近似诊断准确率；置信加权分数Sconf；信息查询Precision/Recall
eval_feature: 多轮, 顺序临床推理
scale: 1,952条生成的结构化病例；经临床验证后保留990条作为评测集
intro_en: VivaBench is a multi-turn viva-style benchmark for sequential clinical reasoning in LLM agents. Models actively request history, examination, imaging, and laboratory evidence across Review and Investigation phases, submit provisional and final diagnoses, and are compared with a full-information condition.
scale_en: 1,952 generated structured cases; 990 clinician-validated cases retained as the evaluation set
metric_en: Top-k exact and approximate diagnostic accuracy at provisional, final, and full-information stages; confidence-weighted Sconf; information-seeking precision/recall
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.10278, Sections 3.1-3.2 and the evaluation equations; official dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/chychiu/VivaBench. The paper defines diagnostic stages dP, dD, and dF; the relevant-investigation condition for interactive top-k scoring; confidence normalization c′ and exact/approximate/unmatched sets E/A/U; and four Review/Investigation by Matched/Full query configurations. Public paper and dataset versions disagree on total size, so the diagram pins the currently verifiable HF views rather than asserting one universal count.. VivaBench structures public clinical vignettes as History/Physical/Imaging/Laboratory cases normalized with SNOMED-CT, LOINC, and ICD-10 and clinically reviewed. Evaluation reports three diagnostic stages: provisional dP after Review, final dD after Investigation, and a Full Information pre-test dF. For dP and dD, each predicted diagnosis is independently classified as exact (E), approximate (A), or unmatched (U), and E/A credit additionally requires an investigation that supports that diagnosis; exact and approximate Top-k are reported separately. dF uses an independent matching path without the investigation condition and does not enter Sconf. For dP/dD, confidence is normalized to c′ with Σc′=1 and Sconf=Σ(i∈E)c′ᵢ+Σ(i∈A)c′ᵢ−Σ(i∈U)c′ᵢ. Information-seeking precision/recall is reported for Review/Investigation by Matched/Full scope. Public versions disagree on total size, so the diagram pins the official HF snapshot of 990 reviewed and about 1.95k generated_raw rows.
